description: MRI through the brain demonstrates a large cerebellopontine angle mass on the right, with a component extending anteriorly into Meckle's cave. The mass is heterogenous on all sequences, and relatively high signal on T2, with avid contrast enhancement, and areas which are presumably cystic.
